description: Add and remove labels on EVERY thread a Gmail search matches, as Gmail's "select all conversations that match this search" does: file a sender under a label and archive it (add the label, remove INBOX), mark old mail read (remove UNREAD). A dry run by default: it returns how many threads match and a sample, and changes nothing. With dry_run false it refuses when the search matches more than `limit`, and otherwise changes every match, listing any thread that failed. To be able to find and reverse a large change later, also add a marker label created for it (e.g. 'cleanup/2026-10').

account.description: Which mailbox this writes to or sends from: a label from list_accounts. Required; there is no default for writes.

add.description: Labels to add, by name or id.

dry_run.description: True (default): count and sample only. False: apply.

limit.description: The most threads one call may change.

query.description: Gmail query syntax, e.g. 'in:inbox from:news.example.com' or 'in:inbox older_than:90d'.

remove.description: Labels to remove: INBOX archives, UNREAD marks read.

name: modify_labels_matching
title: Modify labels on every match
